proposedBy: Codex, implementing Exact LLP 0381 P0a and Snapback LLP 0063 WS8
ratifier: Charlie Cheever, as named by partitime.comparison-protocol.v1

supersedesMetric.name: memoryPerActiveSubscriptionBytes
supersedesMetric.disposition: retained historical one-subscription total-heap result; it is never relabelled as a fitted marginal cost

replacement.passRule: Every Contract cell passes both warmHeapTotalBytesP95 and marginalHeapBytesPerLogicalSubscriptionUpper95 against its same-backend React threshold in the independent holdout.

total.name: warmHeapTotalBytesP95
total.definition: Runtime.getHeapUsage usedSize after first-live-data, closure of the sibling cache-prime target, two requestAnimationFrame turns, and forced garbage collection in the measured target with one canonical feed subscription.

marginal.name: marginalHeapBytesPerLogicalSubscriptionUpper95
marginal.definition: The one-sided 95% upper confidence bound of the OLS slope of post-GC Runtime.getHeapUsage usedSize against active logical subscriber count in the measurement-only sibling entry.
marginal.subscriberShape: Each subscriber observes the same canonical feed descriptor through its arm's public binding API. Provider-level dedup remains enabled; each subscriber owns an independent delivery callback and disposer. No subscriber emits DOM or host nodes.

regression.estimator: ordinary least squares with intercept over all 28 retained cohort observations
regression.negativeSlopePolicy: retain the signed fitted slope and uncertainty; do not clamp observations or the Contract result

marginal.absoluteFloorRationale: Pre-frozen measurement-resolution allowance. It is constant across cells and does not depend on a judged Contract measurement.

sampling.browser: current stable desktop Chrome on the frozen host profile
sampling.countOrder: Fisher-Yates permutation from receipt-recorded seed before every cohort round
sampling.outlierPolicy: retain every valid observation; invalidate only a receipt-recorded collector, browser, backend-health, or cleanup failure
sampling.cohortIsolation: Commit calibration thresholds before holdout. Holdout reads them from the explicit committed calibration revision and never from the mutable worktree.
sampling.cleanup: After every observation dispose all subscriber handles, force garbage collection, and require heap recovery within max(65536 bytes, 5% of the count-1 pre-subscription heap).

forbidden: the judged Contract cell's calibration or holdout value
a threshold selected from the desired pass/fail outcome

historicalV2Holdout.role: immutable pre-amendment evidence; not a replacement calibration

changeControl.beforeRatification: Design, validator, and non-default collector work only. No threshold derivation, keep decision, or claim promotion.
changeControl.afterRatification: Run calibration once, commit it, then run one independently bound holdout. A method change requires a new dated amendment and identities.
changeControl.thresholdLoosening: forbidden outside the ratified invalidation procedure
